label: DISTANCE

cover.headline: Feeling *invisible* at home
cover.sub: 5 gentle ways to be seen again.

points.heading: Name it to yourself first
points.body: Feeling unseen is painful, and it deserves your attention.
points.panel: “I feel overlooked lately, and that matters.”

points.heading: Say it without blame
points.body: A soft start makes it easier for him to hear you.
points.panel: “I’ve been feeling a bit invisible. Can we talk about it?”

points.heading: Ask for something specific
points.body: Small, clear requests are easier to act on.
points.panel: “Would you ask about my day tonight, and really listen?”

points.heading: Notice him too
points.body: Sometimes both people feel unseen at the same time.

points.heading: Make space for you
points.body: Your worth doesn’t depend on being noticed by one person.
points.panel: Do one thing this week just because you enjoy it.

close.save: Save this for when you need it.

caption:
Doing everything and feeling like nobody notices is one of the loneliest feelings in a marriage.

It doesn’t always mean you’re not loved. Often, life has simply gotten loud. These five gentle steps help you speak up, ask clearly, and feel seen again, starting with seeing yourself. You deserve to feel noticed.

Save this for when you need it, and follow @spotseason for more.
